factValues.name: gr:fact-137cf6570e4e2cdb_fv
factValues.value: For the year ending 31 March 2026 the company was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-3b80cee3aa14f45f_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit in accordance with section 476 of the Companies Act 2006.

factValues.name: gr:fact-a42c24023b108c7e_fv
factValues.value: The director acknowledges his responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-8d02e71afb81c1ee_fv
factValues.value: These accounts have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies' regime and in accordance with the provisions of FRS 102 Section 1A - Small Entities. The profit and loss account has not been delivered to the Registrar of Companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9293a96b22c4ae77_fv
factValues.value: The accounts have been prepared in accordance with the provisions of FRS 102 Section 1A Small Entities. There were no material departures from that standard.

factValues.name: gr:fact-46ad67c6db927da2_fv
factValues.value: The accounts have been prepared under the historical cost convention as modified by the revaluation of certain fixed assets.

factValues.name: gr:fact-4559a5f6db778bba_fv
factValues.value: The accounts are presented in £ sterling.

factValues.name: gr:fact-2396183a8455d856_fv
factValues.value: Turnover is measured at the fair value of the consideration received or receivable, excluding discounts, rebates, value added tax and other sales taxes. Turnover from the sale of goods is recognised when goods have been delivered to customers such that risks and rewards of ownership have transferred to them. Turnover from the rendering of services is recognised by reference to the stage of completion of the contract. The stage of completion of a contract is measured by comparing the costs incurred for work performed to date to the total estimated contract costs.

factValues.name: gr:fact-8a7daa4ca3b8d0c8_fv
factValues.value: Tangible assets are included at cost less depreciation and impairment. Depreciation has been provided at the following rates in order to write off the assets over their estimated useful lives:

factValues.name: gr:fact-3758509418bd4530_fv
factValues.value: Intangible fixed assets (including purchased goodwill and patents) are included at cost less accumulated amortisation.

factValues.name: gr:fact-7e815312d24a1a06_fv
factValues.value: Monetary assets and liabilities in foreign currencies are translated into sterling at the rates of exchange ruling at the balance sheet date. Transactions in foreign currencies are translated into sterling at the rates of exchange ruling at the date of the transaction. Exchange differences are taken into account in arriving at the operating profit.

factValues.name: gr:fact-58273577010863db_fv
factValues.value: The director has considered the effect of future events on the company and has determined that they do not create a material uncertainty that casts significant doubt upon the company's ability to continue as a going concern. On this basis, the director considers it appropriate to prepare the financial statements on the going concern basis.
